The '''Juma system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Dalchon sector/Legends|Dalchon sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. This system contained the [[Juma 9]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]], a critical [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] base during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
